svg.text: Level 2: the deployable units, the data each one owns, and the identity carried on every hop. One Cloud Run revision, one bucket, one topic, one database.

or POST /ingest/exam from a surface
8–16 objects arrive per batch
gs://quanta-gradesync-exams
object versioning ON — a replaced
scan archives the prior generation
batches/2026_Matematicas_10A_Parcial1/
{year}_{subject}_{class}_{assessment}
one object per student, stem = the id

exam-batch-ingest

svg.text: FastAPI + uvicorn (uvloop, httptools) — one container, two audiences, Pydantic v2 on every boundary
us-central1 · min 0 / max 2 instances · 1 GiB · request timeout 900 s · scales to zero when idle
POST /webhooks/pubsub — the only door work arrives through

g.text: verifies the shared token · translates the raw object path into a job · claims it so the 8–16
notifications one batch produces start exactly one job · waits for the upload to settle
runs the whole pipeline inside the request and acknowledges only on success

exams that need a decision, the page and
the quoted line, upload, synced grades

review queue with the evidence overlaid

/sis/records · /labels · /jobs/{id}/trace · /fleet/registry · /readyz (Google Frontend reserves /healthz)

svg.text: Identity — one revision, fourteen declared principals

g.text: runtime service account autocurricula-runner@quanta-gradesync.iam.gserviceaccount.com
aiplatform.user · datastore.user · storage.objectAdmin · secretmanager.secretAccessor · run.invoker
an in-process capability gate (DENY > QUARANTINE > ALLOW) checks every external action against
the calling agent's declared capability set before the network call — no agent principal holds sis.write
sis-writer impersonates gradesync-sis-writer@ when GRADESYNC_AGENT_IMPERSONATION_ENABLED=true

svg.text: What this container owns — and what it deliberately does not

g.text: in process: L1 session state per job, the claimed-job set, /tmp/autocurricula/staging for fetched
pages — all of it dies with the instance, by design
durable state lives only in Firestore, so a killed instance loses nothing: the checkpoint is re-read
and finished stages replay instead of re-running (41.0 s first delivery, 2.3 s and 8.0 s resumed)
gemini-3.5-flash — multimodal grading with thinking enabled,
and the calibration evaluator inside the optimizer
gemini-3.5-flash-lite — curriculum audit, armor screen, second-
opinion rework, latency fallback, prompt proposer
text-embedding-005 — 768-dimension L2 embeddings
Gemini 3.x are served from location global; the embedding client
is regional (us-central1). Two locations, one project.
checkpoints — one JobRecord per job_id: stage, per-stage status, error
checkpoints/<job_id>::session — L1 session state, every stage output
profiles — L3 episodic student history across terms
competencies — class snapshots + rubric embeddings, 768-d Vector,
flat index; find_nearest degrades to empty context on API error
reviews — quarantine queue: reasons, evidence spans, gs:// page path
labels — every human approve / dismiss, kept as a training signal
sis_records — the grade ledger /sis/records and the console read
assessment_facts — per-student assessment facts feeding L3 recall
audit — audit/<job_id>/events/<ts>: spans, metrics, capability denials
dead_letter — isolated exams and orphan SIS records, max 3 attempts
prompts — evolved prompt registry: variant id and content hash
jobs — registry collection, empty on the current path

svg.text: each has a real offline implementation — the suite runs with no credentials

g.text: gradesync-push-token:latest, mounted into the revision as
GRADESYNC_PUBSUB_PUSH_TOKEN — never in cloudbuild.yaml,
never on a command line, never in the image
two interchangeable sinks behind one Protocol: the built-in
Firestore sis_records ledger, or HttpSISConnector against the
school's own API (GRADESYNC_SIS_BASE_URL)
a per-record rejection parks in dead_letter and only the orphans
are retried — an accepted grade is never written twice
cloudbuild.yaml, pinned to a
dedicated build identity:
gradesync-builder@
logging.logWriter · artifactregistry.
writer · run.admin · actAs on the
runtime SA · objectViewer on source
us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/
quanta-gradesync/autocurricula/
autocurricula-gradesync:<SHORT_SHA>
every deployed revision is a tagged
image built from a commit — the
running code is always identifiable

svg.text: Identity on every hop, in order

g.text: upload → bucket · runtime SA, storage.objectAdmin
bucket → topic · GCS notification, OBJECT_FINALIZE only
topic → service · OIDC autocurricula-runner@, audience-pinned
service → Vertex AI · aiplatform.user
service → Firestore · datastore.user
service → SIS · sis-writer principal, impersonation optional
build → deploy · gradesync-builder@, run.admin + actAs runner
8-exam batch, push event to completed job: 43.9 s, $0.31275, 16 LLM calls
per exam: 5.0 s of pipeline time and $0.0391
duplicate delivery: 200 duplicate, zero SIS writes, zero recompute
resume after a killed instance: 2.3 s and 8.0 s vs 41.0 s cold
24 of 24 red-team injection attempts caught, 0 false positives
648 offline tests pass with no GCP credentials and no network
